description: Source code for managing membership lifecycle, invoicing, and Razorpay webhook handling in an ERPNext non-profit module.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a membership record with validation, invoice generation, and webhook handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates membership data, creates member from website user if needed, and checks membership period.

methods.name: create_member_from_website_user
methods.description: Creates a Member record based on the current website user session.

methods.name: validate_membership_period
methods.description: Checks and sets the membership period based on last membership and billing cycle.

methods.name: on_payment_authorized
methods.description: Handles actions after payment authorization, including invoice generation.

methods.name: generate_invoice
methods.description: Creates and optionally saves a sales invoice for the membership.

methods.name: validate_membership_type_and_settings
methods.description: Validates membership type and system settings before invoice creation.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a payment entry linked to the invoice.

methods.name: send_acknowlement
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment email to the member.

methods.name: generate_and_send_invoice
methods.description: Generates and sends invoice and acknowledgment email.
